title: La hoja de coca: Cosmovisión ancestral frente al estigma
goal: Analyze the cultural, nutritional, and diplomatic significance of the sacred coca leaf, acullico, and sovereignty.
grammar: etnobotánica de la coca, ritual del acullico, challa a la Pachamama y despenalización internacional

items: Trace the millenary cultural and spiritual significance of the coca leaf and acullico.
Distinguish between natural nutritious coca leaf and illicit refined cocaine.
Deploy ethnobotanical, ritual, and agrarian sovereignty vocabulary (acullico, chuspa, challa, alcaloide).
